headline: Motion requiring monthly General Fund budget reports, FY27 awards, a Justin J. Watt Foundation donation, and five out-of-state travel requests.
summary: The meeting will consider a motion on monthly budget reports and accept FY27 awards and a donation. It also includes a home education request, a memorial, and five out-of-state travel requests.
items: Memorial for Maureen P. Keene, retired paraprofessional from Morey Elementary School
Motion by Fred Bahou to have the Finance Department include updated year-to-date expenditures for all General Fund line items at the first meeting of every month
Approval to accept and expend allocated FY27 awards
Letter of approval for accepting donation from the Justin J. Watt Foundation
Overnight out-of-state travel request: LHS to New York, NY
Overnight out-of-state travel request: LHS to White Plains, NY
Overnight out-of-state travel request: LHS to Philadelphia, PA
Overnight out-of-state request: Community Schools National Network Conference
Overnight out-of-state conference request: ESEA February 2027
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852
